name: io.github.ireinahedad/arakice-nhl
title: ArakIce NHL probabilities
description: NHL pre-game win and puck line probabilities with a public track record; paid calls via x402.

environmentVariables.name: ARAKICE_BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key (0x + 64 hex) of a dedicated buyer wallet holding a little USDC on Base. Optional: without it only the free track record tool works.

environmentVariables.name: ARAKICE_MAX_PER_DAY_USD
environmentVariables.description: Maximum USDC paid per UTC day (default 1.00).

environmentVariables.name: ARAKICE_PAY_TO
environmentVariables.description: Optional seller address to pin; payments to any other address are refused.
